Initial release of skill-scanner.

- Scan any agent skill for security risks using 100% local static analysis.
- Compatible with platforms including CodeBuddy, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, OpenClaw, and more.
- Supports both full-platform and single-skill audit modes.
- No credentials or file contents leave your device.
- Output language matches user request; Chinese and English supported.
